DK27.4 is an ICD-10-DK medical diagnosis code representing chronic or unspecified gastroduodenal ulcer with bleeding [^src1] [^src2]. In the context of the Danish healthcare system's clinical quality monitoring, it serves as a specific data point for tracking severe gastrointestinal bleeding incidents among patients being treated for [[atrieflimren]] [^src1].

The code is part of a comprehensive diagnostic framework utilized by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to calculate the incidence of severe bleeding in the atrial fibrillation patient population [^src1]. To capture all relevant gastrointestinal bleeding events, DK27.4 is grouped within a broader range of codes spanning from [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] to [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]], as well as [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] to [[dk92-2|DK92.2]] [^src1]. This gastrointestinal category is analyzed alongside diagnostic codes for intracranial bleeding (ranging from [[di60|DI60]] to [[ds066|DS066]]) and urinary or respiratory tract bleeding (including [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) to provide a complete epidemiological picture of bleeding complications [^src1]. 

By standardizing the application of DK27.4 and its associated diagnostic codes, the RKKP enables consistent data collection, rigorous quality measurement, and cross-regional comparison of clinical outcomes for cardiovascular patients across Denmark [^src1] [^src2].

## Claims
### Diagnostic
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31) (Page 118) [^src1]
